admission_scope: Complete written-note practice with disclosed expressive limitations; not equivalent reference performance
normalizations: Removed only the fixed MuseScore3.6.2 MusicXML3.1 external DOCTYPE for strict application import. Raw converter output is retained separately; no entity/DTD resolution.
Catalog score ID and attribution were assigned; original imported IDs, musical events, part names, tempo/key/meter/repeats were not altered.
practice_limits: Complete written-note practice edition: source ornaments, fermatas, slurs, dynamics, lyrics and layout are not all reproduced by canonical engraving/playback.

Two turn signs realize six extra attacks in the converter MIDI; two fermatas change its tempo. This practice timeline retains explicit written durations and tempo, not equivalent expressive performance.
Default 61-key range cannot play the unchanged low piano part (MIDI 29–65). Voice (65–77) fits; choose parts/range or an explicit reversible octave copy.
Composition/text by Franz Schubert/Johann Wolfgang von Goethe are historic; CC0 applies to the OpenScore edition. No modern translation, recording or scanned edition is supplied.
